what: trend_donchian_eth_prop's pooled cost headroom (flat all-in break-even 26.6 bps over n=169 OOS trades, 2025-09-28..2026-09-23; Breakout stack ~12.6 bps at an ASSUMED 3 bps spread+slip) is carried by folds 1-2: its last two folds (n=85, 2026-03-27..09-23) break even at 3.4 bps flat, below Breakout's 8 bps commission alone. Descriptive split, read after the pooled result, below the 126-trade power floor, so it is not a verdict. Two measurements: (1) pre-register and run a test of the post-2026-03-27 net edge at Breakout costs; (2) measure the real breakout_1 ETH/SOL spread+slippage. B6 fresh-account EV (room k=0.33) is the most sensitive to this input: at 10 bps vs 3 bps, EV per life falls ~50% (book +$112 -> +$56, 5/3 seeds).
